 Appearance:
 Shri Satyam Agrawal - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Ajay Tamrakar - Panel Lawyer for the State.
 Order

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.17/2024 dated 03.02.2024 registered at Police Station - Siddikhganj, District Sehore for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n),
343 and 109 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 5/6 and 16/17 of the POCSO Act.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant contends that statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of CrPC prima facie reflects that she was in consensual relationship with the present applicant.
It is contended by the counsel that the applicant himself is aged about 21 years and he was not prosecuted for any of the offence in the past.

The co-accused Ankit Malviya on the same set of allegation, has been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 31/05/2024 in M.Cr.C.
No.22230/2024.

Thus, the learned counsel submits that the applicant is custody since 08-02-2024 and charge-sheet in the matter has already been filed, he deserves to be enlarged on bail.
3.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail 2 MCRC-27570-2024 to the applicant.

4 . Thus, considering the totality of the circumstances, including the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of CrPC, age of the applicant as well as period of custody of the applicant and the fact that the co- accused on the same set of allegation has been enlarged on bail by this Court on 31/05/2024 in M.Cr.C. No.22230/2024, this Court deems it proper to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.
